text: 创业板指半日跌1.3%，农业股逆势大涨；中国10年期国债期货升至纪录高位。 恒指半日跌0.7%，恒生科技指数跌2%，恒生生物科技指数逆市涨1.2%。智谱跌超16%，MINIMAX跌超12%。 美国30年期国债收益率升至5.321%，创2007年中期以来最高。 创A股历史纪录！中一签最高爆赚55万，“最贵新股”频准激光首日飙涨595%。 中国央行连续6个工作日7天期逆回购操作量为零，今日开展4697亿元隔夜逆回购操作。
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell 1.3% by midday, while agricultural stocks surged against the trend; China's 10-year government bond futures hit a record high. The Hang Seng Index fell 0.7% by midday, the Hang Seng Tech Index dropped 2%, and the Hang Seng Biotech Index rose 1.2% against the trend. Zhipu fell over 16%, and MINIMAX fell over 12%. The US 30-year Treasury yield rose to 5.321%, the highest since mid-2007. An A-share record: one lot yielded up to 550,000 yuan in profit as the 'most expensive new stock,' Pinpoint Laser, surged 595% on its debut. The PBOC conducted zero 7-day reverse repos for six consecutive working days, and today carried out 469.7 billion yuan in overnight reverse repos.
